figure.design: effect table (a) + held-out sub-attacks (b); chosen by the author on 2026-10-02

encoding.a: cells print the estimate (computed before rounding); split loss = random minus temporal macro-F1 (orange, darker = larger), cleaning gain = R1 minus raw macro-F1 (blue > 0, red < 0)
encoding.upright, no double dagger: the seeds, cuts or runs and, where computed, the 95% block-bootstrap interval lie on one side of 0
encoding.double dagger: the seeds, cuts or runs or the interval do not lie on one side of 0
encoding.dagger: trained after all rules, scored on the test flows that no rule flags (one cell across both split-loss columns)
encoding.b: recall of the true class, seen in training (filled) vs held out (open); XGBoost, temporal split; sub-attacks with raw labels, means with raw labels and R1

notes_a: Split loss: random − temporal split; cleaning gain: R1 − raw labels. Single runs
with seed 42 unless seeds, cuts or runs are given (then means). Upright, no ‡: the
seeds, cuts or runs and, where computed, the 95% block-bootstrap interval lie on
one side of 0; ‡: they do not; italic: one run, no interval; –: not run or not shown;
†: trained after all rules, scored on test flows that no rule flags.
Shading: orange, split loss (darker = larger); blue, positive and red, negative gain.
